findings.quote: The United States also totally rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control for the artificial intelligence being spoken of so much now, hereinafter officially called super intelligence
findings.rationale: Rejects international AI control, renames AI superintelligence, and discusses competition, risks and growth.

findings.quote: The United States leads the world in superintelligence, and we'll continue to do so safely and responsibly.
findings.rationale: Describes promotion, enforcement oversight and responsible development of superintelligence.
